policy.identity: workspace/task/agent/author/request; immutable request retries return original outcome
policy.membership: current generation/tombstone owner remains authoritative; replay never restores explicit removal
policy.persistence: atomic snapshot part/CURRENT writes and conditional assignment mutation; preserve receipt independently of retained UI history
policy.activation: monolith migration0013, dedicated key and receiver configuration are required before worker enablement; compatible API deploy alone does not activate comments

limits: no claim of enabled monolith worker before migration and credential verification

loop.observation: Busy agents lose distinct requests when retries and new submissions share one identity.
loop.hypothesis: Immutable scoped request identities and persisted receipts distinguish retries without restoring removed participants.
loop.execute: Integrate requests into the current atomic membership generation owner and verify concurrent mutations and replay.
loop.evaluate: Request, restart, stale writer, removal, queue and source-contract tests must pass.
loop.retrospective: Keep source-comment authorization server-owned and client activation separate from compatible deployment.
